Use an interface when different classes should follow the same contract without sharing one implementation. It supports substitution, testing, and loose coupling because callers depend on the contract rather than a specific class.

Why is using [] as a Python default argument risky?

In Unity C#, why is Rigidbody movement usually done in FixedUpdate?
Unity runs physics on a fixed timestep. Applying Rigidbody movement in FixedUpdate keeps it synchronized with physics updates and makes the result more consistent.
